name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 7 visits over 44 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 44 hours starting 2025-09-29, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.77 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
